summary: Verified consent-safe Oslo launch-preparation center on preview URL. Backend: 29/29 pytest pass — added test_launch_campaign (asserts consent_required status, contacts_imported=0, '14 dager' timing, Resend sender status, all 4 segments incl. greater-oslo, all 7 required consent fields, template ids launch-invite/launch-reminder/launch-day in order) and test_no_send_or_import_endpoints (asserts POST /launch-campaign/send, /launch-campaign/import, /contacts/import, /campaigns/send all return 404/405). Frontend (Playwright, desktop 1920 + mobile 390): /lansering page renders, consent lock 'Utsending er låst / Venter på dokumentert samtykke' visible, contacts=0 / 14 dager / Resend ikke tilkoblet stats correct, ZERO upload/import/send controls in DOM (queried input[type=file], data-testid*=upload/import-contacts/send-campaign), all 7 required fields (Navn, Bedrift, E-post, Fagområde, Område, Samtykkedato, Samtykkekilde) visible in consent-import-guard, segment toggle updates count 0->2->1 (selected+deselect), templates render with Dag −14 / Dag −7 / Dag 0, copy-signup-link-button triggers 'kopiert' toast, desktop nav-lansering link works, mobile-navigation contains mobile-nav-lansering, mobile 390px page-level scrollWidth==clientWidth==390 (no horizontal overflow), launch-email-templates fits within viewport (x=20,w=350). Regressions: dashboard (/) and /for-fagfolk still reachable. All copy Norwegian.
critical_code_review_comments: LaunchPreparationPage.js has extremely long single-line JSX (lines 28-30 each ~1-2KB) — hurts readability and diff clarity; consider formatting into multiple lines.

copy-signup-link-button shows a success toast but does not actually call navigator.clipboard.writeText — the copy is only cosmetic. If the intent is real UX, wire it to clipboard.writeText(signup_url).
Segment selection state is client-only and not persisted or POSTed anywhere (expected while sending is locked, but worth noting for when consent basis lands).
Backend /api/launch-campaign is a static dict — fine for demo; when real data arrives, move to config or Mongo so status transitions (consent_required -> ready) can be driven from backend.
